title: Cortex SessionStoreRequest (DRAFT v0)
description: Canonical wire shape for POST /sessions/{session_id}/store on mnemos. Mirrors the historical main.py:SessionStoreRequest BaseModel but is the SINGLE source of truth per ADR-0014; main.py imports and re-types it. The keystone is `additionalProperties:false` — without it a producer could inject rogue fields (e.g. undeclared provenance metadata, hidden container overrides, fake session_id claims) that consumers would silently pick up. This schema is a DELIBERATE SUBSET of `memory-store-request.schema.json`: the session-store endpoint server-stamps `container_tag` (from the session) and `session_id` (from the URL path), so the wire body is narrower. Only `raw_text` is required on the wire; every other field is an optional provenance/routing metadata (nullable + server-defaulted where the legacy Pydantic posture allowed None). The `metadata` sub-object keeps `additionalProperties:true` (unlike the parent) because callers do ship opaque blobs here. The keystone rejects UNEXPECTED TOP-LEVEL keys (which is what additionalProperties:false on the parent covers). Status: DRAFT; bump $id on breaking changes. Note: this is the WRITE shape for a session-scoped memory; the read shape (mnemos.db:store_memory row) carries additional server-stamped fields (memory_id, content_hash, indexed_at, container_tag, session_id) that are NEVER accepted on input.

raw_text.description: The memory body. Non-empty. Whitespace-trim happens server-side; the contract is the wire shape, not the post-trim shape.

memory_type.description: Memory class. Defaults to 'episodic' (raw conversation). The 7-value enum covers the producer fleet: 'episodic' (turns) | 'semantic' (consolidated) | 'fact' (atomic claims) | 'raw_session' (session metadata, not body) | 'operational' (system/internal) | 'receipt' (execution-receipt mirror) | 'block' (pinned structural entries).

actor_id.description: Provenance — who is writing (e.g. user id, agent name).

actor_class.description: Provenance — what kind of writer (human | agent | system | cron | mcp-bridge).

confidence.description: Writer-supplied confidence score, 0..1. Null when the writer has no opinion.

source_provider.description: Provenance — originating system (mnemos default; fleet sets 'hermes' | 'cortex' | 'mavis' | etc.).

source_record_id.description: Id of the source record in the producer's namespace (turn id, receipt id, session message id).

metadata.description: Provenance — free-form caller metadata. additionalProperties: true (unlike the parent) because callers do ship opaque blobs here; the keystone still rejects UNEXPECTED TOP-LEVEL keys (which is what additionalProperties:false on the parent covers).
